# golden-files

Golden file assertions for Go tests: update via a flag field, normalizers for line endings and volatile text, line diffs and safe names. Go module `github.com/Trysac/u194-golden-files`, package `goldenfiles`.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): Problem, install, usage example.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Design and public API details.
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): Test suite coverage.
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): Threat model and limits.
